rot.tempo.ideia.ex1.e1: Attack: this is the Philidor position, but it is your move. Zugzwang only works with Black to move: before winning the rook, you must hand the move over.
rot.tempo.ideia.ex1.e2: The plan is the queen triangle: from a5 to e5 and to a1, with check, and back to a5. That is three queen moves against two by the black king, and the move changes sides.
rot.tempo.ideia.ex1.l1: Check on e5, along the diagonal to b8. Blocking with the rook on c7 fails: the queen captures it, protected by your king.
rot.tempo.ideia.ex1.l2: The black king goes to the corner, next to the rook. On c8, it would be mated by the queen on e8.
rot.tempo.ideia.ex1.l3: Check along the a-file: the queen reaches the second corner of the triangle.
rot.tempo.ideia.ex1.l4: The black king returns to b8. Blocking the check with the rook on a7 would allow mate, with the queen on h8.
rot.tempo.ideia.ex1.l5: The queen closes the triangle on a5: the same Philidor position, now with Black to move. It is zugzwang, and the rook falls.
rot.tempo.demos.a7.1: Attack demonstration: after the check on e5, the black king went to a7, not to the corner. Does the triangle still work?
rot.tempo.demos.a7.2: It does: check along the a-file, as before. With the king on a7, the rook cannot even block, and the black king only has b8.
rot.tempo.demos.a7.3: Forced move: the black king returns to b8.
rot.tempo.demos.a7.4: The queen returns to a5: the Philidor position with Black to move, by the same triangle.
rot.tempo.demos.afogar.1: Defence demonstration: after the check on e5 and the king to a8, White put the queen on d6, without check, instead of a1. Think as Black: what resource does the rook have?
rot.tempo.demos.afogar.2: The rook offers itself on b6, with check: it is the only saving move. Capturing it stalemates your king, and running from the check also draws.
rot.tempo.demos.afogar.3: White captures, and your king has no move: stalemate, a draw. With the black king almost out of squares, every quiet move calls for this check.
rot.tempo.pratica.canto.p: Attack: White again, in another corner. Win the rook: first, set up the Philidor position with Black to move.
rot.tempo.pratica.canto.fim: Rook won. The path of this chapter: hand over the move with the queen and let zugzwang do the work.
rot.tempo.pratica.outroCanto.p: Attack: another corner, with the queen farther away. Win the rook and, before every quiet move, check whether the rook can offer itself for stalemate.
rot.tempo.pratica.outroCanto.fim: End of the chapter: the queen hands over the move in a triangle, with checks, and the Philidor position with Black to move wins the rook.
rot.tempo.pratica.fins.afogado: Stalemate: the rook offered itself, and the capture left the black king without a move. Before a quiet move, check for this resource.
rot.tempo.pratica.fins.repeticao: The same position repeated three times: a draw. The triangle is used only once: after it, with Black to move, win the rook.
rot.tempo.pratica.fins.limite: The move limit ran out before the rook fell. Set up the Philidor position with Black to move: there, every black move loses.
rot.tempo.pratica.fins.insuficiente: The queen and the rook left the board, and the material is not enough: a draw. Before every move, check whether the rook can capture the queen.
rot.tempo.pratica.err.solta.1: The queen was left unprotected, within reach of the rook or the black king: it is captured, and now Black is the one winning.
rot.tempo.pratica.err.solta.2: Before every move, check that the queen's new square is protected or out of reach of the rook and the black king.
rot.tempo.pratica.err.espeto.1: The rook gives check on the line joining your king and the queen: it is a skewer. The king steps out of check, and the rook captures the queen.
rot.tempo.pratica.err.espeto.2: Do not leave the queen behind your king, on the same rank or file, if the rook can check from the other side.
rot.tempo.pratica.err.troca.1: The rook captures the queen, and your king recaptures: only the two kings remain, and it is a draw.
rot.tempo.pratica.err.troca.2: On the rook's line and protected only by the king, the queen can be traded off. Put the queen where the rook cannot reach it.
rot.tempo.pratica.err.afoga.1: The rook offers itself with check: capturing it stalemates the black king, and running from the check also draws.
rot.tempo.pratica.err.afoga.2: With the black king almost out of squares, before every quiet move check whether the rook can offer itself.
